words.definition: n. 推动力，促进；动量

examples.en: The new funding gave fresh impetus to the research.
examples.zh: 新资金为这项研究注入了新的推动力。

examples.en: The scandal was the impetus for reform.
examples.zh: 这桩丑闻成了改革的契机。

words.usage: give/provide impetus to（为…注入动力）；the impetus for/behind sth（…的推动因素）高频书面语。同根 impetuous（冲动的）。拉丁义「冲击」。
collocations: give impetus to 注入动力
the impetus for reform 改革的推力
words.mnemonic: im(进)+pet(冲)+us → 往前冲 → 推动力

words.definition: n. 场合，时刻；时机；重大活动 v. 引起

examples.en: On that occasion, I was too nervous to speak.
examples.zh: 在那种场合，我紧张得说不出话。

examples.en: Her promotion was a joyous occasion for the whole team.
examples.zh: 她的升职对全队来说是一件喜事。

words.usage: on this/that occasion（在这个/那个场合）；on occasion（间或）；rise to the occasion（随机应变）高频习语；同根 occasional 偶尔的、occasionally 有时。
collocations: on this occasion 在此场合
rise to the occasion 应对自如
words.mnemonic: oc(向)+cas(落)→ 事落到眼前 → 场合

words.definition: v. 阻塞，堵塞；阻碍，阻挠

examples.en: A fallen rock obstructed the mountain path.
examples.zh: 一块落石堵住了山间小路。

examples.en: He was charged with obstructing justice.
examples.zh: 他被控妨碍司法。

words.usage: obstruct traffic/justice/the view（妨碍交通/司法/视线）；obstruction n. 阻塞（obstruction of justice 妨碍司法）；obstacle n. 障碍物。ob-（逆）+ struct（建）。
collocations: obstruct the view 挡住视线
words.mnemonic: ob(逆)+struct(建)→ 横在建筑物前 → 阻碍

words.definition: n. 策略，花招；（部队）演习；机动动作 v. 巧妙移动；操纵

examples.en: The pilot performed a difficult manoeuvre in the air.
examples.zh: 飞行员在空中完成了一个高难度机动动作。

examples.en: Political manoeuvres delayed the reform for months.
examples.zh: 政治操弄使改革拖延了数月。

words.usage: 英式拼 manoeuvre，美式 maneuver；military manoeuvres（军事演习）；manoeuvre sb into（把某人引入圈套）。来自法语手+工 → 巧妙操作。
words.mnemonic: man(手)+oeuvre(工)→ 用手巧妙操作

words.definition: adj. 多才多艺的；多用途的

examples.en: She is a versatile actress who sings, dances and acts.
examples.zh: 她是一位能歌善舞、戏路宽广的多面手演员。

examples.en: Eggs are a versatile ingredient in cooking.
examples.zh: 鸡蛋是烹饪中用途多样的食材。

words.usage: versat（转）+ ile → 能转向各处 → 多面手；形容人或工具皆可。名词 versatility 多才多艺；与 flexible（灵活）、all-round（全面的）近义。

confusables.note: vertical 垂直的，vert- 同头异义

collocations: a versatile player 全能选手
words.mnemonic: vers(转)+atile → 处处能转 → 多面手

words.definition: v. 分隔，隔离（不同种族、群体）

examples.en: The schools were segregated by race in the past.
examples.zh: 过去学校按种族实行隔离。

examples.en: Recyclable waste is segregated from general rubbish.
examples.zh: 可回收垃圾与普通垃圾分开放置。

words.usage: segregate A from B（把 A 与 B 分开）；racial segregation（种族隔离）历史高频；名词 segregation；反义 integrate（融合）。se-（分离）+ greg（群）。
words.mnemonic: se(离)+greg(群)+ate → 离群 → 隔离

words.definition: adj. 第二的，次要的；（教育）中等的

examples.en: Health comes first; everything else is secondary.
examples.zh: 健康第一，其余都是次要的。

examples.en: She teaches chemistry at a secondary school.
examples.zh: 她在中学教化学。

words.usage: be secondary to（次于…）；secondary school（中学）；secondary sources（二手资料，学术高频）；secondarily adv.。second 的派生族：secondary、secondly。
words.mnemonic: second(第二)+ary → 第二位的 → 次要的

words.definition: n. 港口，海港 v. 庇护；怀有（想法）

examples.en: The fishing boats returned to harbor before the storm.
examples.zh: 渔船赶在风暴前回到港口。

examples.en: He harbours a deep resentment towards his former boss.
examples.zh: 他对前任老板怀有深深的怨恨。

words.usage: 美式拼 harbor，英式 harbour；natural harbor（天然良港）；动词比喻义高频：harbour doubts/grudges/criminals（心怀疑虑/积怨；窝藏罪犯）。Pearl Harbor 珍珠港。
words.mnemonic: 船依停之处 → 港；心里藏事 → 怀有

words.definition: n. 阻塞，堵塞；阻碍，妨碍；障碍物

examples.en: The bridge collapse caused an obstruction in the river.
examples.zh: 桥梁坍塌造成了河道阻塞。

examples.en: He was arrested for obstruction of justice.
examples.zh: 他因妨碍司法被逮捕。

words.usage: obstruction of justice（妨碍司法）法律高频；an obstruction to sth（…的障碍）；动词 obstruct；obstacle 指具体障碍物，obstruction 偏指阻塞行为/物。
collocations: obstruction of justice 妨碍司法
cause an obstruction 造成阻塞
obstruction to progress 进步的阻碍
words.mnemonic: obstruct(阻塞)+ion → 阻塞；妨碍

words.definition: n. 海洛因

examples.en: He was arrested for possession of heroin.
examples.zh: 他因持有海洛因被捕。

examples.en: Heroin addiction destroys lives and families.
examples.zh: 海洛因成瘾摧毁生命与家庭。

words.usage: 不可数；heroin addiction/abuse（海洛因成瘾/滥用）社会新闻高频；原为拜耳注册商标名，取「英雄」之意。与 heroine（女英雄；女主角）音近义远！
words.mnemonic: hero+in → 英雄牌 → 海洛因

words.definition: n. 天鹅绒，丝绒 adj. 天鹅绒的

examples.en: The sofa was covered with dark blue velvet.
examples.zh: 沙发罩着深蓝色天鹅绒。

examples.en: The curtain was made of heavy red velvet.
examples.zh: 幕布由厚重的红色天鹅绒制成。

words.usage: velvet curtain/dress（天鹅绒窗帘/裙）；a velvet voice（柔和圆润的嗓音）； velvet glove（外柔内刚：an iron fist in a velvet glove）。velvety adj. 柔滑的。
words.mnemonic: 摸上去温润如绒 → velvet

words.definition: v. 尖叫，尖声喊 n. 尖叫

examples.en: She screamed when she saw the spider.
examples.zh: 她看到蜘蛛时尖叫起来。

examples.en: The fans screamed with excitement at the concert.
examples.zh: 演唱会上歌迷们兴奋地尖叫。

words.usage: scream at/with（冲…尖叫；因…尖叫）；scream for help（尖叫呼救）；区分 shout（大声喊）、yell（叫喊）、scream（尖叫，音高）。「电视上 screaming headlines 耸人听闻的标题」。
collocations: scream for help 尖叫呼救
scream with excitement 兴奋尖叫
scream one's head off 拼命尖叫
words.mnemonic: scr 音尖锐刺耳 → 尖叫

words.definition: v. 取笑，戏弄；梳理（毛）n. 爱开玩笑的人

examples.en: His classmates used to tease him about his accent.
examples.zh: 同学们过去常拿他的口音取笑他。

examples.en: Stop teasing your little sister!
examples.zh: 别逗弄你妹妹了！

words.usage: tease sb about sth（拿某事取笑某人）；tease out（梳理出、套取出信息）书面高频；teaser 预告片·难题。与 mock（嘲讽，贬义）程度不同。
collocations: tease sb about sth 拿某事打趣
words.mnemonic: tick 逗一下 → tease 取笑

words.definition: n. 厘米（美式拼 centimeter）

examples.en: The insect is only two centimetres long.
examples.zh: 这只昆虫只有两厘米长。

examples.en: Allow a centimetre or two for shrinkage.
examples.zh: 留出一两厘米的缩水余量。

words.usage: centi（百分之一）+ metre（米）；英式 centimetre，美式 centimeter；缩写 cm。同族 kilometre 千米、millimetre 毫米。
collocations: two centimetres long 两厘米长
words.mnemonic: centi(百分)+metre(米)→ 百分之一米

words.definition: n. 一瞥，瞥见 v. 瞥见

examples.en: I caught a glimpse of her face through the window.
examples.zh: 我透过窗户瞥见了她的脸。

examples.en: The documentary offers a glimpse into rural life.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片让人得以一窥乡村生活。

words.usage: catch/get a glimpse of（瞥见）固定搭配；a glimpse into（对…的窥见）；与 glance（有意一瞥）之别：glimpse 是无意的短暂瞥见。
collocations: catch a glimpse of 瞥见
a glimpse of hope 一线希望
words.mnemonic: gl 光一闪而过 → 一瞥

words.definition: v. 欺骗，蒙蔽

examples.en: He deceived his friends about his financial situation.
examples.zh: 他在财务状况上欺骗了朋友。

examples.en: Don't be deceived by her charming smile.
examples.zh: 别被她迷人的微笑蒙蔽了。

words.usage: deceive sb into doing（骗某人去做）；be deceived by（被…蒙蔽）；deceive oneself（自欺）。名词 deceit 欺骗、deception 骗局；同根 -ceive 族：receive、conceive、perceive。
collocations: deceive sb into doing 骗某人做
words.mnemonic: de(坏)+ceive(拿)→ 用手段骗走 → 欺骗

words.definition: n. 海湾，港湾；（建筑）隔间 v.（犬）低吠

examples.en: The village overlooks a sheltered bay.
examples.zh: 村子俯瞰一处避风的海湾。

examples.en: The hounds were baying at the moon.
examples.zh: 猎犬对月低吠。

words.usage: 海湾义：Hudson Bay（哈德逊湾）、a sheltered bay（避风湾）；at bay（走投无路；被围）、keep/hold sth at bay（使…不能逼近）高频习语。
collocations: a sheltered bay 避风海湾
keep sb at bay 使不能逼近
words.mnemonic: 海张开怀抱（b）抱住陆地 → 海湾

words.definition: v. 绑架，劫持 n. 绑架（案）

examples.en: The millionaire's son was kidnapped last week.
examples.zh: 百万富翁的儿子上周遭绑架。

examples.en: Kidnapping for ransom has increased in the region.
examples.zh: 该地区绑架勒索案有所增加。

words.usage: kid（小孩）+ nap（偷）→ 旧指偷拐小孩 → 绑架；过去式/过去分词 kidnapped/kidnaped；kidnapper 绑匪、kidnapping 绑架罪。
words.mnemonic: kid(孩)+nap(偷)→ 偷孩子 → 绑架

words.definition: n. 告别，欢送会 int. 再会（文学）

examples.en: We said our farewells at the airport.
examples.zh: 我们在机场道了别。

examples.en: The team held a farewell dinner for their retiring coach.
examples.zh: 球队为即将退休的教练举办了欢送晚宴。

words.usage: fare（行）+ well（好）→ 一路走好；farewell party/dinner/speech（告别会/晚宴/致辞）；bid farewell to（向…告别）书面高频。比 goodbye 正式、更具仪式感。
words.mnemonic: fare(行)+well(好)→ 一路走好 → 告别

words.definition: adj. 十进制的，小数的 n. 小数

examples.en: The metric system is based on the decimal system.
examples.zh: 公制以十进制为基础。

examples.en: Round the figure to two decimal places.
examples.zh: 把这个数字四舍五入到小数点后两位。

words.usage: decimal point（小数点）、decimal places（小数位）、decimal system（十进制）高频；decim-（十）同根 December（古罗马第十月）、decade。

confusables.note: decimate 大幅摧毁，dec- 同根

collocations: two decimal places 两位小数
words.mnemonic: decim(十)→ 十进制 → 小数
